digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing and alert system
propositions: Auto-bug filers lack dedup logic and file duplicates on repeated failures or single flakes, creating ticket spam
Heartbeat and binding-drift filers in canary_bridge.py and conflict filer in applier.py operate without consistent templating, state tracking, or recovery contracts

Bug filing must be hardened via stable per-check tags, consecutive-red thresholds where applicable, <=1 accumulation comment per 24h, template bodies with abort-if-empty-detail, and detected_by attribution
Heartbeat filer requires consecutive-red threshold (2+ reds) using workflow run history; binding-drift filer requires no threshold (drift is persistent); conflict filer requires per-pair dedup tag
Bug-creation contract must be documented with exact rebar create args, dedup search command, and detected_by env var so all auto-filers produce well-formed tickets
